package ice

import (
	"net"
	"net/netip"
	"os"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

const researchLargeDatagramBytes = 500
const researchFaultAfterDatagrams = 64
const researchBlackholeDuration = 25 * time.Second

var researchUDPCount atomic.Uint64
var researchUDPTime atomic.Uint64
var researchUDPSlow atomic.Uint64
var researchLargeCount atomic.Uint64
var researchFaultStarted atomic.Int64
var researchDropped atomic.Uint64

func researchUDPWrite(conn *net.UDPConn, b []byte, addr netip.AddrPort) (int, error) {
	// A bounded data blackhole preserves small ICE checks, reproducing a live
	// connection whose content cannot complete. Only the diagnostic sender opts in.
	if os.Getenv("WS_WAN_FAULT") == "drop-large-once" && len(b) > researchLargeDatagramBytes {
		count := researchLargeCount.Add(1)
		if count > researchFaultAfterDatagrams {
			now := time.Now().UnixNano()
			researchFaultStarted.CompareAndSwap(0, now)
			if time.Duration(now-researchFaultStarted.Load()) < researchBlackholeDuration {
				researchDropped.Add(1)
				return len(b), nil
			}
		}
	}
	started := time.Now()
	n, err := conn.WriteToUDPAddrPort(b, addr)
	elapsed := time.Since(started)
	researchUDPCount.Add(1)
	researchUDPTime.Add(uint64(elapsed))
	if elapsed >= time.Millisecond {
		researchUDPSlow.Add(1)
	}
	return n, err
}
func ResearchUDPTiming() map[string]uint64 {
	return map[string]uint64{
		"writes": researchUDPCount.Load(), "nanoseconds": researchUDPTime.Load(),
		"slowWrites": researchUDPSlow.Load(), "faultDropped": researchDropped.Load(),
		"faultStartUnixNs": uint64(researchFaultStarted.Load()),
	}
}
